de.title: Handbrause: Dichtung kaputt
de.answer: Die Gummidichtung zwischen Schlauch und Handbrause ist kaputt. Repariere das nicht selbst. Mach ein Foto und zeig es deiner Vorgesetzten.
steps: Hausdame Anna Berger fragen oder Rezeption intern 100 anrufen

en.title: Hand shower: seal broken
en.answer: The rubber seal between the hose and the hand shower is broken. Do not repair it yourself. Take a photo and show it to your supervisor.
steps: Take a photo of the damage
Ask housekeeper Anna Berger or call reception on internal 100
Continue cleaning the room as usual

tr.title: El duşu: conta kırık
tr.answer: Hortum ile el duşu arasındaki lastik conta kırılmış. Kendin tamir etme. Fotoğraf çek ve amirine göster.
steps: Kat şefi Anna Berger'e sor veya resepsiyonu dahili 100'den ara
Odayı normal şekilde temizlemeye devam et
